sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Hydel Development Fund Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HYDEL DEVELOPMENT FUND (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE HYDEL DEVELOPMENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XIII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Hydel Development Fund Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 2nd May, 2002]
No.Legis:I(5)/92/2710/2854,
dated 2-5-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of
the, North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Hydel Development Fund (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

NORTH-WEST

ORDINANCE XIII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Hydel Development Fund Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 2nd May, 2002]
No.Legis:I(5)/92/2710/2854,
dated 2-5-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of
the, North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:
3. Amendment of section 3 of
N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XXVI of 2001.---In, the said Ordinance, in section
3, in subsection (1), the full-stop appearing at the end shall be replaced by a
colon and thereafter the following proviso shall be inserted namely:
"Provided that the erstwhile
Fund with the title 'North-West Frontier Province Development of Hydel
Electricity Fund', established administratively before the commencement of this
Ordinance shall, on establishment of the Fund under this Ordinance, stand
merged with the Fund so established under this Ordinance and shall always be construed
and deemed to have been so merged with effect from .the date of its
establishment. "

5. Amendment of section 7 of
N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. XXVI of 2001.---In the said Ordinance in section
7,--
(a) in subsection (2) for the
expression "Minister for Power and the Secretary Power", the
expression "Chief Secretary, North-West Frontier Province, and the

(b) in subsection (3), the

the 31st August each year, for incorporating in the Civil Accounts.".
